page.overview:
Who is Kabuto's Sensei?

He is a Konohagakure jōnin and the leader of Team Kabuto.

Once a student of Orochimaru along with Anko Mitarashi and another unknown genin, his team entered Chūnin Exams together. During the second exam, they battled against Hayate Gekkō, Ibiki Morino and Tokara. He also made a brief appearance in Naruto: Shippūden episode 193, as part of the tactical division of protecting Konoha alongside Sabiru and other ninja.

He was first seen alongside the other jōnin commanders as the Third Hokage instructed them on the next phase of the examinations, after his Team had passed the second exams and awaited instructions for the third.

He also made another appearance during the Konoha Crush where he cheered on his comrades after the display of their legendary teamwork. He was later seen attending the Third's funeral, mourning his loss with the rest of the villagers.
